label: C* in the MOTION_3 holding sense from respect-general concurrent actualization (inference)
rule: Actualizer premise at the operative respect, then concurrent actualization
meaning: New non-transcription conditional derivation. Let y, distinct from x, presently actualize x in r and be able to lack its act in r. By the actualizer premise y is in act in r; by the respect-general concurrent actualization something other than y presently actualizes y in r. So C* in the holding sense follows from concurrent actualization; it is that premise restricted to the operative acts of movers of another. The converse fails (Control part 3): C* in the holding sense entails neither the respect-general premise nor its esse instance. Both premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
